instructionalToFunctionalBridge.desired: Activity system must track each task execution individually with task-level lifecycle logs and aggregate them into the parent activity record with task count, duration, and cost per task
instructionalToFunctionalBridge.implemented: Added optional duration/cost fields to executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned schema and populated them during task execution using existing computed metrics
instructionalToFunctionalBridge.verified: Static code analysis validation harness confirms schema includes fields and implementation populates them. Build passed with 11 binaries. No conflicts detected.

beforeState.taskTracking: Task lifecycle logs present (Task starting, Task completed)

afterState.persistentMetrics: Available in activity record with duration/cost per task
afterState.longTermAnalysis: Enabled - metrics persisted for historical comparison
